entries.title: The first mate is no longer woken by a crewmate's closing line while its work still runs
entries.body: When other work waits on a task, a crewmate's closing line at the end of a turn no longer wakes the first mate while that task's checks or jobs are still running. The line stays on the task, and a report from the crewmate still reaches the first mate at once. Less of your plan's allowance goes to turns with nothing to do.
entries.noPicture: This changes when the first mate is woken, not how any view looks.
